package soak

// PLANT: one goroutine that never exits, started per request.
// Expected: oracle (b) goroutines FAIL, naming plantGoroutineLeak as the growing stack.
// Oracle (c) does NOT fire: the leak starts in warm-up, so its stack is in the baseline
// (see plant_one_goroutine.go.txt for the case (c) exists for).

import "net/http"

func init() {
	handlerWrappers = append(handlerWrappers, func(next http.Handler, _ *soakEnv) http.Handler {
		block := make(chan struct{})
		plantCleanups = append(plantCleanups, func() { close(block) })
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			go plantGoroutineLeak(block)
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	})
}

func plantGoroutineLeak(block chan struct{}) { <-block }
